cloud-panel-not-allowed: Mō te SuperAdmin anake te Cloud Panel, kei te rohe Cloud Panel.
cloud-settings-desc: Mā WeKan i Weddy, ka tuku te Cloud Panel i ngā rohe WeKan maha mai i te tūmau kotahi, kei ia rohe ōna ake raraunga. Kei te rohe Cloud Panel, ka whakahaere te SuperAdmin i ngā rohe me CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Mā te kī API CloudFlare, ka whiwhi te rohe, kei tō pūkete CloudFlare tōna zone, i tētahi rekoata DNS takawaenga me tētahi tiwhikete CloudFlare Origin. Ka whiwhi ētahi atu rohe i tētahi tiwhikete Let's Encrypt. Ka tiakina te kī ki te tūmau, ā, kore rawa e whakaaturia anō.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Kāore he kī API CloudFlare i tiakina: ka whiwhi ia rohe i tētahi tiwhikete Let's Encrypt.
cloudflare-api-key-set: Kua tiakina tētahi kī API CloudFlare.
